project.name: PC DOQTAR
project.description: Native Windows desktop system-monitoring, diagnostics, and PC health application with optional cloud synchronisation and background diagnostic reporting.

desktop_application.language: Java 21 (BellSoft Liberica JDK 21.0.4 recommended for packaging)
desktop_application.build_system: Apache Maven (compiler release 21, source encoding UTF-8)

connection_service.database: MySQL (hosted on Aiven Cloud, service host: mysql-pc-doqtar-pc-doqtar.c.aivencloud.com, db: pc_doqtar)
connection_service.cloud_auth: Firebase Admin SDK (Firebase ID token verification filter)

packages.org.pcdoqtar.lifecycle: Application lifecycle, dependency wiring (ApplicationServices), clean shutdown (ShutdownManager), error alerts.
packages.org.pcdoqtar.ui: UI views, custom title bar, page definitions (Overview, Diagnostics, Network, Processes, Settings), and AccountControl.
packages.org.pcdoqtar.ui.navigation: Page registry, sidebar navigation factory, view switcher controller.
packages.org.pcdoqtar.ui.components: Reusable UI cards, metric displays, warning indicators.
packages.org.pcdoqtar.ui.theme: ThemeManager (Light and Dark theme switching, inline style re-tinting, CSS loading).
packages.org.pcdoqtar.diagnostics: Diagnostics orchestrator (SystemDiagnostics), health evaluation rules, async task execution (DiagnosticTaskManager).
packages.org.pcdoqtar.diagnostics.storage: Physical disk and file store capacity diagnostics.
packages.org.pcdoqtar.diagnostics.network: Network interface collection (physical/virtual filtering, traffic counters, Cloudflare speed test).
packages.org.pcdoqtar.diagnostics.process: Running processes retrieval, PID inspection, and resource tracking.
packages.org.pcdoqtar.auth: Firebase authentication REST client, AuthSession, AuthenticationCoordinator, LoginDialog.
packages.org.pcdoqtar.connection: Backend HTTP client (ServerConnection), payload transformation (SnapshotMapper), handover orchestration (ServerHandover), and retry queue (SyncCoordinator).
packages.org.pcdoqtar.settings: Persistent user preferences via Java Preferences API (AppSettings).

packages.com.pcdoqtar.application.security: FirebaseAuthenticationFilter (Bearer token validation via Firebase Admin).
packages.com.pcdoqtar.application.service: DiagnosticService (save, compare, and historical query logic).
packages.com.pcdoqtar.application.entities: JPA entities: Diagnosticrecord, DiagnosticSnapshot, MetricDetail, StorageMetric.

important_classes_and_responsibilities.ApplicationLifecycle: Orchestrates primary Stage initialisation, custom window styling, unhandled startup errors, and clean shutdown.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.ApplicationServices: Central service container holding singletons for AuthSession, FirebaseAuthService, AuthenticationCoordinator, SystemDiagnostics, NetworkDiagnostics, DiagnosticTaskManager, ServerHandover, and SyncCoordinator.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.ThemeManager: Manages Dark/Light palette switching, applies theme CSS files, dynamically re-tints inline node styling at runtime without page reconstruction.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.CustomTitleBar: Undecorated window title bar handling window dragging, double-click maximisation, minimize, maximize, close, and embeds AccountControl.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.AccountControl: Title-bar component providing optional Firebase Sign-in, sign-out, manual 'Sync now', and real-time synchronisation status pills.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.SystemDiagnostics: Facade collecting system snapshots across CPU, memory, storage, and coordinating diagnostic sub-services.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.DiagnosticTaskManager: ThreadPoolExecutor-backed worker manager handling async diagnostic collections on background threads.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.DiagnosticServiceMain: Background Windows service that writes periodic diagnostic snapshots every 5 minutes to %PROGRAMDATA%\PCDOQTAR\latest-diagnostics.json.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.SyncCoordinator: Single-flight cloud sync manager with persistent on-disk queue (%PROGRAMDATA%\PCDOQTAR\pending-sync), exponential backoff with jitter (5s, 10s, 20s, 30s, 60s), and live network probe detection.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.ServerConnection: HTTP client handling REST communication with the backend (/sessions, /getsession, /api/diagnostics/upload).
important_classes_and_responsibilities.SnapshotMapper: Maps client SystemHealthSnapshot models into the backend DiagnosticUploadRequest JSON schema.
important_classes_and_responsibilities.AppSettings: Persistent user preferences (theme, warning threshold, navigation collapsed by default) backed by Windows Registry via Java Preferences.

startup_flow: 2. JavaFX runtime initialises and invokes DashboardApp.start(Stage).
3. ApplicationLifecycle instantiates ApplicationServices (AuthSession, FirebaseAuthService, SystemDiagnostics, NetworkDiagnostics, DiagnosticTaskManager, ServerHandover, SyncCoordinator).
4. SyncCoordinator loads any pending offline records from %PROGRAMDATA%\PCDOQTAR\pending-sync.
5. DashboardViewFactory builds Overview, Diagnostics, Network, Processes, and Settings pages, wiring NavigationController and SidebarFactory.
6. CustomTitleBar is attached to root top, AccountControl is injected, and undecorated Stage parameters (min width 1000, min height 700) are configured.
7. Active theme from AppSettings is applied via ThemeManager.apply(scene).
8. Stage is shown, and initial Overview scan is triggered on background daemon thread.
shutdown_flow: 1. Stage close requested via CustomTitleBar close button or window event.
2. ShutdownManager catches event and invokes ApplicationLifecycle.shutdown().
3. ApplicationServices closes SyncCoordinator (cancels scheduler, flushes pending state).
4. DiagnosticTaskManager shuts down thread pool immediately (shutdownNow).
7. Platform.exit() terminates JavaFX runtime and JVM exits cleanly.

ui_architecture_and_navigation.shell_structure: BorderPane root containing CustomTitleBar (Top) and dashboard shell (Center). Dashboard shell contains HBox navigation toolbar (Top with hamburger button and page title), Collapsible Sidebar (Left), and ScrollPane-wrapped active page (Center).
ui_architecture_and_navigation.navigation_drawer: Hamburger button toggles sidebar visibility (shell.setLeft(sidebar / null)). Configurable default collapsed state stored persistently via AppSettings.isNavigationCollapsedByDefault().
ui_architecture_and_navigation.sidebar: 190px width brand block with navigation buttons: Overview, Diagnostics, Network, Processes, Settings. Active page marked with '.active' CSS class.
ui_architecture_and_navigation.theming: Immediate runtime switching between Dark (default) and Light. Colors defined as CSS variables (-app-background, -app-surface, -app-accent, -app-warning, -app-critical, etc.) bound to .root, .theme-dark, and .theme-light. ThemeManager automatically re-tints existing nodes.

diagnostic_and_monitoring_implementation.cpu: CpuDiagnostics uses OSHI CentralProcessor; calculates system-wide CPU load percentage and per-core distribution; flags normal (<80%), warning (>=80%), or critical (>=90%).
diagnostic_and_monitoring_implementation.memory: MemoryDiagnostics uses OSHI GlobalMemory; calculates available vs total RAM bytes, page file usage, and utilisation percentage.
diagnostic_and_monitoring_implementation.storage: StorageDiagnostics iterates OSHI OSFileStore list; computes free/total bytes and utilisation for each active drive letter.
diagnostic_and_monitoring_implementation.network: NetworkDiagnostics collects NetworkInterface and OSHI NetworkIF metrics (link speed, RX/TX byte totals, IPv4/IPv6, MAC). Filters out virtual, loopback, and filter miniports. NetworkPerformanceTest runs HTTP latency and throughput benchmarks via Cloudflare endpoints.
diagnostic_and_monitoring_implementation.processes: ProcessesPage queries OSHI OperatingSystem.getProcesses (top 200 sorted by resident RAM). Normalises cumulative CPU load to available processor count. Supports PID/name filtering.
diagnostic_and_monitoring_implementation.process_termination: End Task validates against protected system processes (PID <= 4, self PID, and Windows system processes). Requires explicit user confirmation dialog. Uses ProcessHandle.destroy() with permission error reporting.

backend_integration_and_api_contracts.strict_rule: NEVER change or invent API endpoints, paths, query parameters, payloads, or authentication headers without explicit user instruction.

GET /sessions.purpose: Verifies server MySQL database connectivity via SessionFactory native query.

GET /getsession.purpose: Generates and returns a unique session UUID string.

POST /api/diagnostics/upload.purpose: Uploads single diagnostic snapshot from desktop client.
POST /api/diagnostics/upload.response: 201 Created JSON with recordId, status, and historicalComparison.

POST /api/diagnostics/upload-batch.purpose: Uploads an array of diagnostic snapshots in a single call.
POST /api/diagnostics/upload-batch.response: 201 Created JSON array of upload responses.

GET /api/diagnostics/latest.purpose: Retrieves the most recent diagnostic snapshot for the authenticated user.

GET /api/diagnostics/history?limit=20.purpose: Retrieves historical diagnostic records for authenticated user.

auth_flow: 1. Client uses Firebase Authentication REST API (Identity Toolkit v1).
2. LoginDialog requests email/password; calls FirebaseAuthService.signIn() or signUp().
3. Tokens (idToken, refreshToken, uid, email, expiresIn) stored in AuthSession.
4. Valid ID token is refreshed automatically when within 60s of expiration.
5. Password reset requests dispatched via sendOobCode REST API with privacy preservation (does not leak email existence).
6. Client authenticates to Spring Boot connection service via HTTP Authorization: Bearer <idToken>.
sync_flow: 1. Sync is triggered manually via 'Sync now' or queued upon scan/handover.
2. SyncCoordinator uses Single-Flight lock (atomic boolean); drops duplicate parallel uploads.
3. Connectivity is verified via socket ping to server host and public DNS resolvers (1.1.1.1:443 / 8.8.8.8:53).
4. Failed uploads are persisted locally to disk in %PROGRAMDATA%\PCDOQTAR\pending-sync as JSON files.
5. SyncCoordinator schedules exponential backoff retries (5s, 10s, 20s, 30s, 60s max) with random jitter.
6. On HTTP 401, attempts token refresh before re-queueing. On HTTP 429, respects Retry-After header. On 4xx client errors, ceases retry loop to prevent infinite loops.
7. On HTTP 200/201 success, pending disk file is deleted and status is updated to 'Sync Success'.

desktop_app.FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY: Required for optional cloud authentication and password reset. Resolved dynamically across Java system properties (-DFIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=..., -Dfirebase.web.api.key=...), process environment variables (FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY, FIREBASE_API_KEY), and Windows User Registry (HKCU\Environment) so that keys set via Windows User Settings are resolved even if the parent terminal/IDE process was started before setting the variable.
desktop_app.PC_DOQTAR_SERVER_URL: Optional URL override for local backend testing (default: https://pc-doqtar-connection-service.vercel.app).
desktop_app.PROGRAMDATA: Windows system variable pointing to C:\ProgramData (used for PCDOQTAR diagnostic JSON storage).

connection_service.DB_URL: JDBC connection URL for Aiven MySQL (jdbc:mysql://mysql-pc-doqtar-pc-doqtar.c.aivencloud.com:port/pc_doqtar?sslmode=require).
connection_service.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: Path to Firebase Admin Service Account JSON or inline credentials.

packaging_and_deployment_procedures.maven_build: mvn clean package (compiles JAR, copies dependencies and application JAR to target/jpackage-input, runs jpackage).
packaging_and_deployment_procedures.service_bundle: Staged under dist/PCDOQTAR-Service with PCDOQTARService.exe (WinSW), classes, and lib-minimal.
packaging_and_deployment_procedures.installer_compilation: Inno Setup Compiler (ISCC.exe) dist/PCDOQTAR-Setup.iss producing dist/PCDOQTAR-Setup.exe.
packaging_and_deployment_procedures.installer_actions: Installs GUI to {autopf}\PC DOQTAR\GUI, Service to {autopf}\PC DOQTAR\Service, adds HKCU Run autostart key PCDOQTAR_GUI, installs and starts PCDOQTARService.

completed_features: Core system diagnostics collecting real CPU, RAM, and drive utilization via OSHI.
Overview page with CPU, Memory, and Storage usage PieCharts and health status cards.
Detailed Diagnostics page with individual metric evaluation (Normal, Warning, Critical).
Process Manager displaying top 200 processes sorted by RAM with search filter and safe End Task termination.
Network page showing filtered physical active adapters, MAC, IPv4, IPv6, throughput, and Cloudflare speed test.
Full Dark and Light themes with dynamic runtime switching via ThemeManager without UI restarts.
Custom title bar with window controls (drag, minimize, maximize, close) and integrated AccountControl.
Optional Firebase email/password authentication (Sign in, Sign up, Forgot password, and Settings password reset).
Single-flight cloud synchronization with exponential backoff retry and persistent disk storage in %PROGRAMDATA%\PCDOQTAR\pending-sync.
Background Windows Diagnostic Service (DiagnosticServiceMain) updating latest-diagnostics.json every 5 minutes.
Spring Boot connection service deployed to Vercel with MySQL persistence on Aiven and Firebase Bearer authentication.
Comprehensive automated JUnit 5 test suite (46 passing tests covering auth, sync, account control, settings, and themes).
known_bugs_and_outstanding_work: Session persistence across restarts: AuthSession is currently purely in-memory; tokens are lost when the desktop application closes. User is required to re-authenticate on every launch.
Network diagnostics missing Default Gateway and DNS: AdapterInfo currently collects IP and MAC, but does not query NetworkParams for default gateway and DNS servers.
Process Manager post-termination UX: The process list does not automatically re-scan after 'End task' succeeds; it requires the user to click 'Scan processes' manually.
Hardcoded inline styles in ProcessesPage: ProcessesPage contains hardcoded inline styles (e.g. #101010) instead of clean CSS class references.
Unused legacy classes: LoginFrame (Swing-based JFrame) and duplicate FirebaseAuthClient regex-based client remain in the codebase.
Network interface filtering: Some VPN or tunnel virtual adapters may still slip past name-based filter list.

architectural_decisions_and_constraints.strict_api_stability: Never modify existing backend endpoints, routes, methods, or request/response payloads.
architectural_decisions_and_constraints.offline_first: Local diagnostics must run with zero internet connection or account requirements; cloud sync is strictly optional.
architectural_decisions_and_constraints.ui_thread_safety: All background tasks must dispatch JavaFX updates via Platform.runLater().
architectural_decisions_and_constraints.theme_coherence: Theme styles must be managed centrally; avoid hardcoding static dark colors in component Java code.
architectural_decisions_and_constraints.process_safety: Never terminate critical Windows OS processes (PID <= 4, csrss, lsass, winlogon, svchost, etc.) or PC DOQTAR itself.
